nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What component serves as the working electrode in a dye-sensitive solar cell?
nodes.answer: A thin layer of nanocrystalline TiO2 serves as the working electrode in a dye-sensitive solar cell.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What role does the N3 dye play in DSSCs?
nodes.answer: The N3 dye, a ruthenium complex, is a popular adsorption sensitizer on nanocrystalline TiO2 surfaces that collects and transports photoelectrons, contributing to high photovoltaic performance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Why is the mesoporous structure of nanocrystalline TiO2 anodes important in DSSCs?
nodes.answer: The mesoporous structure of the nanocrystalline TiO2 anode is important because it promotes dye diffusion and adsorption, facilitates incident light flow and brightness, and enhances the efficiency of electron transmission.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What technique has been proven to increase the visible light capture capabilities of DSSCs?
nodes.answer: Co-sensitization with additional dyes for panchromatic engineering is the proven technique.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are the effects of heptyl and ethyl carbazole when added to the bridged system in relation to the bandgap and electro-chemical features?
nodes.answer: The addition of heptyl and ethyl carbazole minimizes the bandgap and boosts the electro-chemical, optical, and photovoltaic features.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Solar photovoltaic systems|Advancements in solar panel materials_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What spectroscopic technique was employed to analyze the components and functional groups of the materials?
nodes.answer: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) was used to analyze the components and functional groups of the materials.
